testRunner_comment: `testFiles` as its own option rather than Stryker's, so a top-level entry is
ignored in silence and its default `*.spec.*` patterns match nothing here -
Stryker then exits with `No tests were executed`.
commandRunner_comment: `bun test src`, not `bun test`. Mutation runs in a sandbox: a copy of this
package alone, instrumented sources, a moved cwd. A test that depends on
anything but the mutated code: a neighbouring manifest, the repo layout,
the transpiler: fails there and nowhere else, so the run is restricted to
the tests that live next to the mutated code. Root tests still run under
`bun test` and in CI; they simply kill no mutant.
excludedMutations_comment: Aligned with core: only BlockStatement is excluded. ConditionalExpression,
EqualityOperator, LogicalOperator, BooleanLiteral and StringLiteral are
exactly the ones that ask whether a branch is really tested.
thresholds_comment: Measured 2026-09-18, after `precompile-core` merged in as `src/core/`, every
mutator but BlockStatement: 69.75% (494 killed, 4 timeouts, 216 survived,
0 uncovered). `break` at 64 leaves ~5 points of slack, like core's. It is a
ratchet: when the score rises, this number rises with it.
